 ----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ajay Singh Poonia For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mangal Singh Saini, PP  Mr. Dhruv Tailor for  Complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR UPMAN  Order 17/01/2024 1.

The instant bail application has been filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioners, who have been arrested in connection with FIR No.44/2022 registered at Police Station Harmada, District Jaipur (West) for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
2.

It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioners that the accused-petitioners have falsely Atmaram S/O Late Shri Girdharilal vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:2798) on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194355455/
1 been implicated in this case.
He submits that vide order dated 28.03.1987, mutation of land [2024:RJ-JP:2798] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-449/2024] was allowed in favour of the petitioners by the court of Assistant Settlement Officer, Amber.
The said order was subsequently affirmed by the Revenue Board.
Petitioners are in possession of the land in question.
It is further submitted that petitioners are old aged persons.
He further submits that the alleged offences are based on documents and same are in possession of Investigating Agency.
There are no criminal antecedents of the petitioners.
Petitioners are in custody since 26.12.2023.
Charge-sheet has been filed and trial will take considerable time.
Further custody of the petitioners would not serve any fruitful purpose.
3. Learned Public Prosecutor assisted by the learned counsel for complainant opposes the bail application.
Learned counsel for the complainant submits that in order to take possession of the land in question, forged documents were prepared by the petitioners.
4. I have considered the contentions.

5. Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case; considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the petitioners, especially the fact that the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate; absence of criminal antecedents; charge-sheet has been filed as well as looking to the custody period, but without commenting anything on the merits/demerits of the case, I deem it proper to allow the bail application.
6.

The bail application is accordingly allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioners -(1)
Atmaram S/o Late Shri Girdharilal and (2) Gopallal S/o Late Shri Girdharilal shall be released on bail provided each of them furnishes a personal bond [2024:RJ-JP:2798] (3 of 3)
[CRLMB-449/2024] in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) each to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court with the stipulation that they shall appear before that Court and any court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J GAUTAM JAIN /115 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
